summary: Phase 4 Architecture Checkpoint (Checkpoint 2 of 3) for Evan Spiegel skill domain. Contains the full 13-workflow specification table with trigger conditions, inputs/outputs, key steps, and cross-expert stacking chains. Includes the detailed production plan for SKILL.md, genius.md, and all 13 workflow files, with registration instructions for slash commands, agent index, and domain registry. Organized into 3 tiers: Foundation (Distribution Audit, Moat Architecture, Innovation Engine), Practitioner (Design Bottleneck, Ecosystem Build, Customer Empathy, Founder Evolution, Distribution Launch, Close-Friends Strategy, Screenshot Mindset), and Stacking (JTBD Agent Architect, Dual-Org Sprint, Distribution-First Offer).
